arguments.command:
python -c "
from itertools import combinations_with_replacement
from more_itertools import combination_with_replacement_index

# Test combination_with_replacement_index
elements = 'ABC'
r = 2

# Get all combinations with replacement
combs = list(combinations_with_replacement(elements, r))
print('All combinations:', combs)

for comb in combs:
    idx = combination_with_replacement_index(comb, elements)
    expected = combs.index(comb)
    status = 'OK' if idx == expected else 'FAIL'
    print(f'  {comb} -> index {idx} (expected {expected}) [{status}]')
"
